name: Barkly Tableland
reason: A region of cattle country, not a place with a defined thing to see; the region name is for a destination or tag, not a spot. Wikivoyage page is a region.

name: Barrow Creek Hotel
reason: Famous 1926 outback pub with tin ceiling and messages covering the walls; a quirky venue, but a pub and named only by a regional guide site (Discover Central Australia) and ExplorOz, so one weak-counted source.

name: Devils Marbles
reason: Karlu Karlu: headline landscape with three counted sources, a walking path and a Dark Sky Sanctuary; open all hours.

name: Heartbreak Hotel
reason: A roadhouse (accommodation and operator base) rather than a place; the draw is Cape Crawford Lost City, judged separately.

name: Iytwelepenty / Davenport Range National Park
reason: National park named by Wikivoyage, NT tourism and Parks NT; waterholes, wallabies and 4WD tracks. Pin must be a visitor point, not the centroid.
